tips.text: Bring Wukong with Cloud Walker; he passes lasers invisible and is the usual Spy pick, with duration and efficiency modded.
Subsume Perspicacity onto your frame; it auto-hacks consoles and works where ciphers are banned.
Go solo while learning and wander a vault before completing it; a public teammate can fail a vault and waste the roll.
Summon a hacking MOA through the glass in front of the vault console and let it hack for you; keep a backup if it snags.
Use Limbo in the rift, Loki or Nova to cross laser grids; cameras and drones still see Limbo.
Do not void-dash past lasers or trapped doors with your Operator; it trips them.
Equip the Parazon mod that grants invisibility on a successful hack to cover the gap between casts.
Skip Lua for Spy; its vaults are puzzle rooms and slower per run.
Buy the main blueprint from the Market before you run a single mission; it is not a Tier 3 drop.
Start all three component builds together so Ivara's 3-day build begins after one 12-hour wait.
Take Ivara in her Circuit week if you can wait; most current players pick it over Spy for having no RNG.
Almost nobody regrets owning Ivara, even after a long Spy farm.
